####process PCA to add gene names to loadings and scale arrows

```{r}

# Ensure gene names exist
if (!"gene_name" %in% colnames(PCA_loadings)) {
  PCA_loadings$gene_name <- rownames(PCA_loadings)
}

# Select top genes by contribution
n_arrows <- 50
loadings2 <- PCA_loadings %>%
  mutate(contrib = PC1^2 + PC2^2) %>%
  slice_max(contrib, n = n_arrows)

# Scale loadings so arrows fit in score space
arrow_scale <- max(abs(c(PCAdata$PC1, PCAdata$PC2)), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
loadings2 <- loadings2 %>%
  mutate(PC1s = PC1 * arrow_scale,
         PC2s = PC2 * arrow_scale)

# Axis labels with explained variance
pc1_lab <- paste0("PC1 (", scales::percent(pca_res$var_exp[1], accuracy = 0.1), ")")
pc2_lab <- paste0("PC2 (", scales::percent(pca_res$var_exp[2], accuracy = 0.1), ")")

# === Biplot ===
p_biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = PCAdata,
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition, shape = replicate),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings2,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc")), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings2,
                  aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = gene_name),
                  size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0) +
  labs(x = pc1_lab, y = pc2_lab, title = "PCA biplot (VST, DESeq2)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_biplot)

ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_PCA_biplot_loadings_DESeq2.pdf"),
       plot = p_biplot, width = 6.5, height = 5)

ggplot(PCA_loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = PCA_loadings %>% slice_max(PC1^2 + PC2^2, n = 50),
                  aes(label = gene_name), size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Gene loadings on PC1 and PC2",
       x = "PC1 loading", y = "PC2 loading")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_PCA_loadings_dotplot.pdf"),
       width = 6.5, height = 5)

```


####run GO enrichment test on top 50 ###PC1
PC1 Cl6 (neg)-Cl18 (pos)
PC2 Cl 6 ct 8dd and 24h SB (neg) Cl 18 and Sb late (pos)

```{r}
# Run enrichment tests (GO or KEGG)
ego_pc1_pos <- enrichGO(gene = top_pc1_pos_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        readable = TRUE)

ego_pc1_neg <- enrichGO(gene = top_pc1_neg_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        readable = TRUE)

#  Visualize results
library(enrichplot)

dotplot(ego_pc1_pos,showCategory = 15, title = "Top PC1 Positive Loadings– GO BP")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_", "GO_PC1pos.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 12)
dotplot(ego_pc1_neg,showCategory = 15, title = "Top PC1 Negative Loadings – GO BP")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_", "GO_PC1neg.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 12)

# For KEGG instead:
ekegg_pc1_pos <- enrichKEGG(gene = top_pc1_pos_entrez$ENTREZID, organism = "hsa")
ekegg_pc1_neg <- enrichKEGG(gene = top_pc1_neg_entrez$ENTREZID, organism = "hsa")

dotplot(ekegg_pc1_pos, showCategory = 15, title = "KEGG enrichment (PC1 positive)")
```

####GSEA on PC1 and PC2

```{r}

# Rank all genes by PC1 loading
gene_ranks_pc1 <- PCA_loadings$PC1
names(gene_ranks_pc1) <- PCA_loadings$gene_name

# Convert gene symbols to ENTREZ IDs

                              toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
gene_ranks_pc1 <- gene_ranks_pc1[match(gene_ranks_pc1_entrez$SYMBOL, names(gene_ranks_pc1))]
names(gene_ranks_pc1) <- gene_ranks_pc1_entrez$ENTREZID

# Rank all genes by PC2 loading

names(gene_ranks_pc2) <- PCA_loadings$gene_name

# Convert gene symbols to ENTREZ IDs

                              toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
gene_ranks_pc2 <- gene_ranks_pc2[match(gene_ranks_pc2_entrez$SYMBOL, names(gene_ranks_pc2))]
names(gene_ranks_pc2) <- gene_ranks_pc2_entrez$ENTREZID

# Run GSEA PC1
gsea_pc1 <- gseGO(geneList = sort(gene_ranks_pc1, decreasing = TRUE),
                  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                  ont = "BP",
                  minGSSize = 10,
                  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                  verbose = FALSE)


gsea_pc1@result$.sign <- ifelse(gsea_pc1@result$NES >= 0, "pos", "neg")

                  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
```

####make plots for specific genes by Deseq2 data normalized

```{r}

order=c("cl6_TGF_ct",
        "cl6_SB_24h",
        "cl6_TGF_8d",
        "cl6_SB_8d",
        "cl18_TGF_ct",
        "cl18_SB_24h","cl18_TGF_8d","cl18_SB_8d")

col=c("cl6_TGF_ct"="#000000","cl18_TGF_ct"="#f0E442","cl6_TGF_8d"="#CC79A7","cl18_TGF_8d"="#009E73","cl6_SB_24h"="#0072B2","cl18_SB_24h"="#E69F00","cl6_SB_8d"="#D55E00","cl18_SB_8d"="#56B4E9")


geneInfo_f <- geneInfo_f %>%
  mutate(gene_name = ifelse(
    gene_ID == "MYOD1",          # the custom one you added
    "MYOD1exo",                  # rename it
    gene_name                    # keep all others unchanged
  ))

genes_to_plot=c("SIX3","ZEB2","DLK1","ZIC1","ZIC5","POU5F1","NANOG","NANOGxt","NODAL","LEFTY1","UNC5C","UTF1","DPPA5")
g_info_plot=geneInfo_f[ geneInfo_f$gene_name %in% genes_to_plot , c("gene_ID","gene_name") ]
genes_to_plot_ensb=g_info_plot$gene_ID

#dd <- plotCounts(dds, gene=c("ENSG00000122180"), intgroup=c("condition","name","replicate","name_R"), returnData=TRUE)
#gene_symbol <- geneInfo_f$gene_name[ geneInfo_f$gene_ID == "ENSG00000122180" ]
#colnames(dd)[ colnames(dd) == "count" ] <- gene_symbol

intgroup      <- c("condition","samp","replicate","sample_ID")

# helper: match Ensembl (with or w/o version) to row index in dds
ens_dds_raw    <- rownames(dds)
ens_dds_novers <- sub("\\..*$","", ens_dds_raw)
get_idx <- function(ens_id) {
  key <- sub("\\..*$","", ens_id)
  idx <- which(ens_dds_novers == key)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(integer(0))
  if (length(idx) == 1) return(idx)
  # if multiple rows, pick the most expressed by total normalized counts
  nc <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)[idx, , drop=FALSE]
  idx[ which.max(rowSums(nc, na.rm=TRUE)) ]
}

# build one small dd per gene, keep only keys + this gene's counts (renamed)
dd_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(g_info_plot)), function(i) {
  ens  <- g_info_plot$gene_ID[i]
  sym  <- g_info_plot$gene_name[i]
  idx  <- get_idx(ens)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)  # silently skip if not found in dds
  dd_i <- plotCounts(dds, gene = idx, intgroup = intgroup, normalized=TRUE
,returnData = TRUE)
  colnames(dd_i)[ colnames(dd_i) == "count" ] <- sym
  # keep only join keys + this gene column
  dd_i[, c(intgroup, sym), drop=FALSE]
})

# drop missing
dd_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), dd_list)
if (length(dd_list) == 0) stop("None of the requested genes were found in 'dds'.")

# merge all by the requested columns
dd_merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = intgroup, all = TRUE), dd_list)
dd_merged <- dd_merged %>%#change replicate to factor with levels 1,2,3
  mutate(
    r = factor(
      sub("^[A-Za-z]+", "", as.character(replicate)),
      levels = c("1", "2", "3")
    )
  )

#dd_merged=dd_merged[dd_merged$name!="hiPSC", ]


ggplot(dd_merged, aes(x = factor(condition,levels=order), y = POU5F1)) +
  # Boxplot: same box per cell type (no grouping by condition)
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
  # Jitter: condition affects shape and color
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = r, color = condition), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
  #geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
   #           map_signif_level = TRUE,
    #          test = "wilcox.test")+
  scale_colour_manual(name="condition",values=col)+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  labs(
    title = "POU5F1 expression by cell type and condition",
    y = "DESeq2 normalized counts (log(1+x))",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_POU5F1.pdf"),
       width = 8, height = 5)

# Loop through each gene
for (gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # Skip if gene column not present
  if (!(gene %in% colnames(dd_merged))) {
    message("Skipping ", gene, " (not found in dd_merged)")
    next
  }

  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(dd_merged, aes(x = factor(condition,levels=order), y = .data[[gene]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = r, color = condition), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
      #geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
              #map_signif_level = TRUE,
              #test = "wilcox.test")+
    scale_colour_manual(name="condition",values=col)+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(gene, " expression by cell type and condition"),
      y = "DESeq2 normalized counts (log(1+x))",
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw()+
    theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_", gene, ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, height = 5
  )

  message("Saved plot for ", gene)
}
```

####DEG analysis between cfr_Cl6_TGF_ct_vs_Cl18_TGF_ct controls

```{r}
#In meta I already placed my contrast columns starting with "cfr_"
#in case cfr_columns do not exist just create them. Place in the comparison the condition name (meta$condition relative to the sample) and the samples not analyzed will have "no" instead.
# Identify contrast columns (those starting with "cfr_")
contrast_cols <- grep("^cfr_", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)
contrast_cols
# Pick one contrast manually for now (first one)
contrast_col <- contrast_cols[5]#cfr_Cl6_TGF_ct_vs_Cl18_TGF_ct column (need to check the contrast col)
contrast_col

# Prepare metadata for this contrast
meta_cfr <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_ID, condition, replicate, !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cfr = !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cfr != "no")

# Subset DESeq2 object to relevant samples
dds_sub <- dds[, colnames(dds) %in% meta_cfr$sample_ID]
dds_sub$group <- factor(meta_cfr$cfr)
#levels(dds_sub$group) #check level of contrast
# (Optional — set whichever condition you want as baseline)
dds_sub$group <- relevel(dds_sub$group, ref = levels(dds_sub$group)[1])
# --- Define new design formula ---
design(dds_sub) <- ~ group
# Run DESeq2
dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

# Define contrast (2 levels only)
cfr_levels <- levels(dds_sub$group)
res <- results(dds_sub, contrast = c("group", cfr_levels[1], cfr_levels[2]))

# Clean result table
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df <- res_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
  left_join(geneInfo_f, by = "gene_ID") %>%
  arrange(padj)

res_df=res_df%>%dplyr::filter(!gene_ID %in% c("COM_K", "dCAS9","MCP_PH_TagBFP","OPTetR"))#eliminate gene names not needed
```

####create a table to store all the data on specific comparisons

```{r}
###set the comparisons you want to do

comparisons=c("cfr_Cl6_TGF_ct_vs_SB_24h",
              "cfr_Cl18_TGF_ct_vs_SB_24h",
              "cfr_Cl6_TGF_8d_vs_SB_8d",
              "cfr_Cl18_TGF_8d_vs_SB_8d",
              "cfr_Cl6_TGF_ct_vs_Cl18_TGF_ct",
              "cfr_Cl6_SB_24h_vs_Cl18_SB_24h",
              "cfr_Cl6_TGF_8d_vs_Cl18_TGF_8d",
              "cfr_Cl6_SB_8d_vs_Cl18_SB_8d",
              "cfr_Cl6_TGF_ct_vs_TGF_8d",
              "cfr_Cl18_TGF_ct_vs_TGF_8d","cfr_Cl6_SB_24h_vs_SB_8d","cfr_Cl18_SB_24h_vs_SB_8d")

first_to_compare=c("cl6_TGF_ct","cl18_TGF_ct","cl6_TGF_8d","cl18_TGF_8d","cl6_TGF_ct","cl6_SB_24h","cl6_TGF_8d","cl6_SB_8d","cl6_TGF_ct","cl18_TGF_ct","cl6_SB_24h","cl18_SB_24h")

###create an empty list to store all the DEG results
deg_results_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(comparisons)) {
  contrast_col <- comparisons[i]
  ref_level    <- first_to_compare[i]
  message("Processing contrast: ", contrast_col, "  (reference = ", ref_level, ")")

  meta_cfr <- meta %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_ID, condition, replicate, !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cfr = !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(cfr != "no")

  dds_sub <- dds[, colnames(dds) %in% meta_cfr$sample_ID]
  dds_sub$group <- factor(meta_cfr$cfr)

  # relevel to make sure first_to_compare is the reference
  if (ref_level %in% levels(dds_sub$group)) {
    dds_sub$group <- relevel(dds_sub$group, ref = ref_level)
  } else {
    warning("Reference ", ref_level, " not found in ", contrast_col)
  }

  design(dds_sub) <- ~ group
  dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

  # contrast = "comparison vs baseline"
  cfr_levels <- levels(dds_sub$group)
  res <- results(dds_sub, contrast = c("group", cfr_levels[1], cfr_levels[2]))

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
    left_join(geneInfo_f, by = "gene_ID") %>%
    arrange(padj)

  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- res_df
}

# --- user-defined thresholds --- add directionality
fc_cutoff <- log2(2)   # change as needed, e.g. log2(2) for 2× fold change
padj_cutoff <- 0.05      # adjust significance threshold

# --- refine and label each DEG table ---
for (contrast_col in comparisons) {
  message("Processing contrast for final table: ", contrast_col)
  
  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] %>%
   # dplyr::filter(!gene_ID %in% c("COM_K", "dCAS9","MCP_PH_TagBFP","OPTetR"))%>%#eliminate gene names not needed
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = case_when(
        padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange >  fc_cutoff ~ "Up",
        padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    ) 
}

deg_results_list_preprocessed=deg_results_list
#make a dataframe with all the results

# --- user-defined thresholds ---
fc_cutoff <- log2(2)   # change as needed, e.g. log2(2) for 2× fold change
padj_cutoff <- 0.05      # adjust significance threshold

# --- refine and label each DEG table ---
for (contrast_col in comparisons) {
  message("Processing contrast for final table: ", contrast_col)
  
  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, direction) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_log2FC") := log2FoldChange,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_pvalue") := pvalue,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_padj")   := padj,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_direction") := direction
    )
}

library(purrr)
# --- merge all contrasts into one big table ---
deg_merged <- purrr::reduce(deg_results_list, full_join, by = c("gene_ID", "gene_name"))
de_stats <- deg_merged

#save as txt and RDS
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_DEG_all_comparisons_cfr.txt")
write.table(deg_merged, file=filename, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_DEG_analysis.RData")
save(deseq_counts,geneInfo_f,counts_f,meta,dds,counts_tpm,deg_results_list,deg_merged,deg_results_list_preprocessed,
     file = Rdata_filename)
```

####calculate nb of DEGs per comparison

```{r}
# Extract only the *_direction columns
direction_cols <- grep("_direction$", colnames(deg_merged), value = TRUE)

# Build a long-format table (gene_ID, gene_name, comparison, direction)
deg_long <- deg_merged %>%
  select(gene_ID, gene_name, all_of(direction_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(direction_cols),
    names_to = "comparison",
    values_to = "direction"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # clean comparison name (remove "_direction" suffix)
    comparison = str_remove(comparison, "_direction$")
  )

# Count Up / Down / NS per comparison
deg_summary <- deg_long %>%
  group_by(comparison, direction) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # optional: pivot wider to have separate columns for Up/Down/NS
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n_genes, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(comparison)

print(deg_summary)

write.table(
  deg_summary,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_DEG_summary_counts.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

g=as.data.frame(t(deg_summary))
colnames(g)=g[1,]
g=g[-1,]
g$direction=rownames(g)

deg_summary_long <- deg_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Up, Down, NS),
               names_to = "direction", values_to = "count")

ggplot(deg_summary_long, aes(x = comparison, y = count, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "DEG summary per comparison",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#CC79A7", "Down" = "#009E73", "NS" = "grey70")) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_volcano_deseq2, "_DEG_summary_barplot.pdf"),
     width = 8, height = 6)
```

## ============================================================
## TIMECOURSE-LIKE ANALYSIS with DESeq2
## ============================================================

```{r}

## ---------------------------
##Set factor reference levels
## ---------------------------
#Set factors + reference levels (important for interpretable coefficients) in current dds object
colData(dds)$cell_type  <- factor(colData(dds)$cell_type,  levels = c("cl6","cl18")) ###cl 6 is WT and baseline while Cl 18 is modified
colData(dds)$treatment  <- factor(colData(dds)$treatment,  levels = c("TGFb","SB"))###TGFb is the baseline and SB is inhibition treatment
colData(dds)$tt         <- factor(colData(dds)$tt,         levels = c("24h","8d"))#This sets 24h as the reference level.

## keep only 24h/8d samples (recommended safety) for timecourse-like analysis
###you also divide dds (original) to dds0 (subset with only 24h and 8d for timecourse)
dds0 <- dds[, dds$tt %in% c("24h","8d")]
dds0$tt <- droplevels(dds0$tt)

design(dds0) <- ~ cell_type * treatment * tt

############################################################
##########1) ANALYSIS of TIME and INTERACTIONS via LRTs complex model
############################################################

## ============================================================
## 1) Fit full model once (Wald) to get interpretable log2FCs
## ============================================================
dds_wald <- DESeq(dds0)  # default test = Wald
rn_full <- resultsNames(dds_wald) ###you can see later specifications of the model columns
print(rn_full)
#this creates a sort of fold change that means "how much the treatment×time interaction differs in cl18 compared with cl6"
#Concretely:
#	•	compute (SB-TGFb) at 8d and at 24h
#	•	take the difference: (SB-TGFb at 8d) − (SB-TGFb at 24h) = treatment×time interaction
#	•	then compare that interaction between cell lines:
#	•	[interaction in cl18] − [interaction in cl6] = the 3-way term

#LRT results don’t have a single meaningful log2FC (they test a set of coefficients). So for LRT-based “comparisons”, the clean thing is to store stat/pvalue/padj and (optionally) add an effect-size column from a Wald coefficient that corresponds to the main term you care about (e.g., the 3-way coefficient, or the treatment×time coefficient within each cell line).

#####resultsNames(dds_wald) ###see what all the columns mean:
#"Intercept" Baseline mean expression for the reference group:cl6 + TGFb + 24h
#"cell_type_cl18_vs_cl6" cell_type: cl6 reference → cl18_vs_cl6 At TGFb + 24h, how cl18 differs from cl6
#"treatment_SB_vs_TGFb"treatment: TGFb reference → SB_vs_TGFb At cl6 + 24h, how SB differs from TGFb
#"tt_8d_vs_24h"  time: 24h reference → 8d_vs_24h At cl6 + TGFb, how 8d differs from 24h
#"cell_typecl18.treatmentSB" treatment effect at 24h differs between cell lines [(SB − TGFb) in cl18 at 24h] − [(SB − TGFb) in cl6 at 24h]
#"cell_typecl18.tt8d" This asks whether the time effect under TGFb differs between cell lines [(8d − 24h) in cl18 under TGFb] − [(8d − 24h) in cl6 under TGFb]
#"treatmentSB.tt8d"This is the classic treatment × time interaction in the reference cell line (cl6): how the time effect differs between treatments [(SB at 8d − SB at 24h) − (TGFb at 8d − TGFb at 24h)] in cl6 (“does SB-vs-TGFb change from 24h to 8d in cl6?”) ###this is for the 2 way interaction mainly for cl6
#"cell_typecl18.treatmentSB.tt8d" This is the difference of the treatment×time interaction between cell lines:{[(SB − TGFb) at 8d − (SB − TGFb) at 24h] in cl18}− {[(SB − TGFb) at 8d − (SB − TGFb) at 24h] in cl6} ###this is for the 3 way interaction

# From the full model fit:
res_coef_trtTime_cl6  <- results(dds_wald, name = "treatmentSB.tt8d")
res_coef_3way         <- results(dds_wald, name = "cell_typecl18.treatmentSB.tt8d")

# BASELINE EFFECT: main effect coefficients (reference group = cl6 + TGFb + 24h)
res_coef_trt_24h_cl6   <- results(dds_wald, name = "treatment_SB_vs_TGFb")  # SB vs TGFb at 24h in cl6 ### CL6 treatment effects (SB vs TGFb) 24h (baseline)
res_coef_time_TGFb_cl6 <- results(dds_wald, name = "tt_8d_vs_24h")          # 8d vs 24h under TGFb in cl6

## Baseline cell line difference: cl18 vs cl6 at TGFb + 24h
res_coef_cell_baseline <- results(dds_wald, name = "cell_type_cl18_vs_cl6")

###ENDPOINT EFFECT:
# (A) SB vs TGFb at 8d in cl6 ### CL6 treatment effects (SB vs TGFb) 8d
# = (SB vs TGFb at 24h in cl6) + (treatment×time interaction in cl6)
res_coef_trt_8d_cl6 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(c("treatment_SB_vs_TGFb", "treatmentSB.tt8d")))

# (B) Time effect (8d vs 24h) under SB in cl6
# = (time under TGFb in cl6) + (treatment×time interaction in cl6)
res_coef_time_SB_cl6 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(c("tt_8d_vs_24h", "treatmentSB.tt8d")))

### CL18 treatment effects (SB vs TGFb)
# (C) SB vs TGFb at 24h in cl18
# = (SB vs TGFb at 24h in cl6) + (cell_type×treatment at 24h)
res_coef_trt_24h_cl18 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(c("treatment_SB_vs_TGFb", "cell_typecl18.treatmentSB"))
)

# (D) SB vs TGFb at 8d in cl18
# = (SB vs TGFb at 24h in cl6)
#   + (cell_type×treatment at 24h)
#   + (treatment×time in cl6)
#   + (3-way: extra interaction in cl18)
res_coef_trt_8d_cl18 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(c("treatment_SB_vs_TGFb",
                    "cell_typecl18.treatmentSB",
                    "treatmentSB.tt8d",
                    "cell_typecl18.treatmentSB.tt8d"))
)

## ============================================================
## 1a) LRTs on the full dataset
## ============================================================
###Is the time effect different between cl6 and cl18? This assess any global time-related effect
##any time related effect (isolates cell_type:tt) (time main + time interactions)
dds_time_LRT <- DESeq(dds0, test="LRT", reduced = ~ cell_type * treatment) ###full design testing here is ~ cell_type * treatment* tt
res_time_any <- results(dds_time_LRT)
head(res_time_any[order(res_time_any$padj), ]) 

###1b) Is the treatment×time interaction different between cell lines? This assess any global time-related effect that is treatment-specific
##Isolates cell_type:treatment:tt: ##3-way only: cell line specificity of treatment×time
dds_3way_LRT <- DESeq(dds0, test="LRT",
  reduced = ~ cell_type + treatment + tt + cell_type:treatment + cell_type:tt + treatment:tt
)
res_3way_LRT <- results(dds_3way_LRT)


############################################################
##########2) ANALYSIS split model (easier to interpret) (cl6 and cl18): LRT for treatment×time in each cell line
############################################################
###2a) Within each cell type, what is the time effect in TGFb treatment? what happens for cl6?

#d <- dds[, dds$cell_type == "cl6"]
#d$tt <- droplevels(d$tt)
#d$treatment <- droplevels(d$treatment)
#design(d) <- ~ treatment * tt

#d_int_cl6 <- DESeq(d, test="LRT", reduced = ~ treatment + tt) # Test the interaction only: does treatment effect change over time?
#res_int_cl6 <- results(d_int_cl6)

###2b) Within each cell type, what is the time effect in TGFb treatment? what happens for cl18?cl6?
run_split <- function(dds_in, ct) {
  d <- dds_in[, dds_in$cell_type == ct]
  d$cell_type <- droplevels(d$cell_type)
  d$treatment <- droplevels(d$treatment)
  d$tt        <- droplevels(d$tt)

  design(d) <- ~ treatment * tt

  d_wald <- DESeq(d)  # Wald fit to extract coefficient log2FCs
  rn <- resultsNames(d_wald)

  d_int_LRT <- DESeq(d, test="LRT", reduced = ~ treatment + tt)  # tests treatment:tt
  res_LRT <- results(d_int_LRT)

  list(d_wald = d_wald, rn = rn, res_LRT = res_LRT)
}

cl6_fit  <- run_split(dds0, "cl6")
cl18_fit <- run_split(dds0, "cl18")

## Get the interaction coefficient name inside each split model
coef_int_cl6  <- grep("treatment.*tt", cl6_fit$rn,  value = TRUE)[1]
coef_int_cl18 <- grep("treatment.*tt", cl18_fit$rn, value = TRUE)[1]

res_int_cl6_lfc  <- results(cl6_fit$d_wald,  name = coef_int_cl6)
res_int_cl18_lfc <- results(cl18_fit$d_wald, name = coef_int_cl18)


## ============================================================
## 5) Build tables like your pairwise workflow + thresholds/direction
## ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
})

fc_cutoff   <- log2(2)
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

## Stringent thresholds (new)
fc_cutoff_strict   <- log2(4)
padj_cutoff_strict <- 0.01


prep_term_table <- function(res_obj,
                            comp_name,
                            geneInfo_f,
                            lfc_res_obj = NULL,
                            pval_cutoff_top = 0.05,
                            topN_vec = c(50, 100)) {

  df <- as.data.frame(res_obj) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(geneInfo_f, by = "gene_ID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_name = dplyr::coalesce(.data$gene_name, .data$gene_ID)) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$gene_ID, .data$gene_name, .data$stat, .data$pvalue, .data$padj)

  if (!is.null(lfc_res_obj)) {

    lfc_df <- as.data.frame(lfc_res_obj) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$gene_ID, .data$log2FoldChange)

    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::left_join(lfc_df, by = "gene_ID")

    ## ----------------------------
    ## 1) standard direction (padj + FC)
    ## ----------------------------
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        direction = dplyr::case_when(
          .data$padj < padj_cutoff & .data$log2FoldChange >  fc_cutoff ~ "Up",
          .data$padj < padj_cutoff & .data$log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff ~ "Down",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        ),
        ## 2) stringentdirection (padj + stronger FC)
        stringentdirection = dplyr::case_when(
          .data$padj < padj_cutoff_strict & .data$log2FoldChange >  fc_cutoff_strict ~ "Up",
          .data$padj < padj_cutoff_strict & .data$log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff_strict ~ "Down",
          TRUE ~ "NS"
        )
      )

    ## ----------------------------
    ## 3) stringentdirection50 / 100 (pvalue + top/bottom N by log2FC)
    ## ----------------------------
    # default "other"
    df$stringentdirection50  <- "other"
    df$stringentdirection100 <- "other"

    # significant by pvalue (not padj)
    sig <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$pvalue), .data$pvalue < pval_cutoff_top,
                    !is.na(.data$log2FoldChange), is.finite(.data$log2FoldChange))

    if (nrow(sig) > 0) {

      # order for Up and Down
      sig_up   <- sig %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$log2FoldChange))
      sig_down <- sig %>% dplyr::arrange(.data$log2FoldChange)

      # function to set labels for a given N
      set_top_bottom <- function(N) {
        up_ids   <- head(sig_up$gene_ID,   n = min(N, nrow(sig_up)))
        down_ids <- head(sig_down$gene_ID, n = min(N, nrow(sig_down)))
        list(up_ids = up_ids, down_ids = down_ids)
      }

      tb50  <- set_top_bottom(50)
      tb100 <- set_top_bottom(100)

      df$stringentdirection50[df$gene_ID %in% tb50$up_ids]   <- "Up50"
      df$stringentdirection50[df$gene_ID %in% tb50$down_ids] <- "Down50"

      df$stringentdirection100[df$gene_ID %in% tb100$up_ids]   <- "Up100"
      df$stringentdirection100[df$gene_ID %in% tb100$down_ids] <- "Down100"
    }

  } else {

    ## LRT-only tables (no FC available): keep everything NA
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        log2FoldChange = NA_real_,
        direction = NA_character_,
        stringentdirection = NA_character_,
        stringentdirection50 = NA_character_,
        stringentdirection100 = NA_character_
      )
  }

  ## Rename with prefixes (NOTE: no "_direction" suffix for the 50/100 columns)
  df %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_stat")                := .data$stat,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_pvalue")              := .data$pvalue,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_padj")                := .data$padj,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_log2FC")              := .data$log2FoldChange,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_direction")           := .data$direction,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_stringentdirection")  := .data$stringentdirection,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_stringentdirection50")  := .data$stringentdirection50,
      !!paste0(comp_name, "_stringentdirection100") := .data$stringentdirection100
    )
}
deg_results_list_TC <- list()

## LRT_time_any: global time-related effect (no single log2FC; keep stats only)
deg_results_list_TC[["LRT_time_any"]] <-
  prep_term_table(res_time_any, "LRT_time_any", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_coef_time_TGFb_cl6)

## LRT_3way: attach true 3-way coefficient log2FC for direction
deg_results_list_TC[["LRT_3way"]] <-
  prep_term_table(res_3way_LRT, "LRT_3way", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_coef_3way)

## Split interaction LRTs: attach interaction coefficient log2FCs
deg_results_list_TC[["LRT_int_cl6"]] <-
  prep_term_table(cl6_fit$res_LRT, "LRT_int_cl6", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_int_cl6_lfc)

deg_results_list_TC[["LRT_int_cl18"]] <-
  prep_term_table(cl18_fit$res_LRT, "LRT_int_cl18", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_int_cl18_lfc)

## BESELINE EFFECT: Wald coefficient tables (interpretable log2FCs)
deg_results_list_TC[["Wald_trt_24h_cl6"]] <-
  prep_term_table(res_coef_trt_24h_cl6, "Wald_trt_24h_cl6", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_coef_trt_24h_cl6)

deg_results_list_TC[["Wald_time_TGFb_cl6"]] <-

###ENDPOINT EFFECT: “simple effects” tables (linear combinations)

deg_results_list_TC[["Wald_trt_8d_cl6"]] <-
  prep_term_table(res_coef_trt_8d_cl6, "Wald_trt_8d_cl6", geneInfo_f, lfc_res_obj = res_coef_trt_8d_cl6)

##Cl6 vs Cl18 at baseline (T0 24h) and TGFb

                  geneInfo_f,
                  lfc_res_obj = res_coef_cell_baseline)

## Merge into one big table
de_stats_TC <- purrr::reduce(deg_results_list_TC, dplyr::full_join, by = c("gene_ID", "gene_name"))

## Save
write.table(
  de_stats_TC,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_DESeq2_timecourse_terms.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

save(
  de_stats_TC, deg_results_list_TC,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_DESeq2_timecourse_terms.RData")
)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## ####How to interpret the “direction” columns here:
## -  LRT_time_any_direction is NA (by design), because there isn’t one log2FC for “any time effect”.
#LRT_time_any_*: padj/stat tells you "any time-related effect"; no single log2FC.

## - LRT_3way_direction uses the 3-way coefficient log2FC (a genuine model coefficient).
#LRT_3way_log2FC: true 3-way coefficient (cl18 vs cl6 difference in treatment×time).

## - LRT_int_cl6_direction / LRT_int_cl18_direction use the treatment×time coefficient within each cell line:
#LRT_int_cl6_log2FC / LRT_int_cl18_log2FC: treatment×time coefficient within each cell line.
##   "Up” means the treatment effect increases from 24h to 8d (given your reference levels SB and 24h)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
```

###make volcano plots for each timepoint comparison

```{r}

ok_pal <- c("Up" = "#CC79A7", "Down" = "#009E73", "NS" = "grey70")

volcano_from_df_prefix <- function(df, prefix, title,
                                   subtitle="Volcano Plot",
                                   pCutoff=0.05, FCcutoff=log2(2),
                                   left_label=NULL, right_label=NULL,
                                   out_pdf=NULL, ok_pal=NULL) {

  xcol <- paste0(prefix, "_log2FC")
  ycol <- paste0(prefix, "_padj")
  dcol <- paste0(prefix, "_direction")

  stopifnot(xcol %in% names(df), ycol %in% names(df), dcol %in% names(df))

  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[xcol]]), is.finite(.data[[xcol]]),
           !is.na(.data[[ycol]]), is.finite(.data[[ycol]]))

  if (nrow(d) == 0) stop("No plottable rows for prefix: ", prefix)

  colCustom <- NULL
  if (!is.null(ok_pal)) colCustom <- ok_pal[d[[dcol]]]

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    d,
    #lab = d$gene_name,
    lab = rep("", nrow(d)),
    x = xcol,
    y = ycol,
    pCutoff = pCutoff,
    FCcutoff = FCcutoff,
    title = title,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    caption = paste0("Cutoff: padj < ", pCutoff, " & |log2FC| > ", round(FCcutoff, 2)),
    pointSize = 2.0,
    colCustom = colCustom,
    colAlpha = 0.5,
    #drawConnectors = TRUE,
    drawConnectors = F,
    widthConnectors = 0.1,
    colConnectors = "black",
    labSize = 5,
    boxedLabels = FALSE,
    max.overlaps = 10,
    legendLabSize = 10,
    legendIconSize = 3.5,
    borderWidth = 0.6,
    axisLabSize = 12
  )

  ymax <- max(-log10(d[[ycol]]), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
  if (!is.null(left_label)) {
    p <- p + annotate("text",
      x = min(d[[xcol]], na.rm=TRUE),
      y = ymax,
      label = left_label,
      hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(right_label)) {
    p <- p + annotate("text",
      x = max(d[[xcol]], na.rm=TRUE),
      y = ymax,
      label = right_label,
      hjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
    )
  }

  p <- p + theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")
  )

  if (!is.null(out_pdf)) {
    ggsave(filename = out_pdf, plot = p, width = 8, height = 8)
  }
  p
}
```

#####GSEA analysis on timecourse analysis

```{r}

## ============================================================
## GSEA (GO:BP) for all comparisons in deg_results_list_TC
## Outputs: CSV + dotplot PDF only
## ============================================================

set_min_n_genes <- 5
set_max_n_genes <- 800
show_k <- 15
nPermSimple <- 10000

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 1) Build ranked gene lists (SYMBOL -> rank) for each comparison
## ------------------------------------------------------------

make_rank_vector <- function(df, min_genes = 10) {
  # find the log2FC column in this table
  lfc_col <- grep("_log2FC$", names(df), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(lfc_col)) return(NULL)

  # need gene_name + log2FC
  if (!("gene_name" %in% names(df))) return(NULL)

  ranks <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, !!lfc_col) %>%
    dplyr::rename(rank = !!lfc_col) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "",
                  !is.na(rank), is.finite(rank)) %>%
    # if duplicated symbols exist, keep the one with max |rank|
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(rank))) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (nrow(ranks) < min_genes) return(NULL)

  v <- as.numeric(ranks$rank)
  names(v) <- ranks$gene_name
  sort(v, decreasing = TRUE)
}

gene_sets_GSEA <- purrr::imap(deg_results_list_TC, ~ make_rank_vector(.x, min_genes = 10))
gene_sets_GSEA <- gene_sets_GSEA[!vapply(gene_sets_GSEA, is.null, logical(1))]

if (!length(gene_sets_GSEA)) stop("No valid ranked gene lists found in deg_results_list_TC.")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZ once
## ------------------------------------------------------------

all_syms <- unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names)))
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(all_syms, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3) Run gseGO for each comparison + save CSV + dotplot
## ------------------------------------------------------------

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

save_plot <- function(p, file, w=8, h=15) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {

  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym),
                   rank   = as.numeric(ranks_sym),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by="SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) {
    message("Skipping ", nm, " (no SYMBOL->ENTREZ mapping).")
    next
  }

  # deduplicate ENTREZ (keep max |rank|)
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  if (length(ranks_entrez) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", nm, " (too few ENTREZ-mapped genes: ", length(ranks_entrez), ").")
    next
  }

  gsea <- tryCatch(
    gseGO(
      geneList      = ranks_entrez,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      ont           = "BP",
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = set_max_n_genes,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,           # keep all; you can filter later
      nPermSimple   = nPermSimple,
      verbose       = FALSE,
      by            = "fgsea"
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("GSEA error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )

  if (is.null(gsea) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea)) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", nm, " (no enriched terms).")
    next
  }

  gsea_list[[nm]] <- gsea

  gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  tab <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- tab

  # write CSV
  out_csv <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GSEA_", nm, ".csv")
  write.csv(tab, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Wrote: ", out_csv)

  # dotplot
  k <- min(show_k, nrow(tab))
  p <- tryCatch(
    dotplot(gsea, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
      facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
      ggtitle(paste0("GSEA GO:BP - ", nm)),
    error = function(e) { message("Dotplot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )

  out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
  save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = 8, h = 15)
}

## Optional: save everything as an RData
Rdata_filename <- paste0(fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, "_GSEA_timecourse_terms.RData")
save(gene_sets_GSEA, gsea_list, GSEA_tables, file = Rdata_filename)
message("Saved: ", Rdata_filename)
```

## ============================================================
## DEG summary (Up/Down/NS) for selected comparisons from deg_results_list_TC
## ============================================================

```{r}
## 1) Choose comparisons (must match list keys)
select_comp <- c(
  "Wald_cell_cl18_vs_cl6_TGFb_24h",
  "Wald_trt_24h_cl18",
  "Wald_trt_24h_cl6",
  "Wald_trt_8d_cl18",
  "Wald_trt_8d_cl6"
)

## 2) Keep only those that exist
select_comp_present <- intersect(select_comp, names(deg_results_list_TC))
if (length(select_comp_present) == 0) stop("None of select_comp found in deg_results_list_TC")

deg_results_list_sel <- deg_results_list_TC[select_comp_present]

## 3) Merge selected comparisons into one table
deg_sel_merged <- purrr::reduce(
  deg_results_list_sel,
  dplyr::full_join,
  by = c("gene_ID", "gene_name")
)

## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Helper: build summary objects for a given suffix:
##   suffix = "_direction" OR "_stringentdirection"
## ------------------------------------------------------------------
make_deg_summary <- function(deg_merged, select_comp_present, suffix, file_tag,
                             fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, fname_prefix_volcano_deseq2) {

  ## pick columns only for the selected comparisons + requested suffix
  cols_wanted <- paste0(select_comp_present, suffix)
  cols_present <- intersect(cols_wanted, colnames(deg_merged))
  if (length(cols_present) == 0) {
    stop("No columns found for suffix: ", suffix,
         "\nExpected something like: ", cols_wanted[1])
  }

  ## Long format
  deg_long <- deg_merged %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, dplyr::all_of(cols_present)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = dplyr::all_of(cols_present),
      names_to  = "comparison",
      values_to = "direction"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison = stringr::str_remove(comparison, paste0(stringr::fixed(suffix), "$")),
      direction  = tidyr::replace_na(direction, "NS"),
      comparison = factor(comparison, levels = select_comp_present),
      direction  = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"))
    )

  ## Summary table
  deg_summary <- deg_long %>%
    dplyr::count(comparison, direction, name = "n_genes") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = direction,
      values_from = n_genes,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(comparison)

  ## Save summary table
  write.table(
    deg_summary,
    file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_DEG_summary_counts_selected_", file_tag, ".txt"),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )

  ## Barplot
  ok_pal <- c("Up" = "#CC79A7", "NS" = "grey70", "Down" = "#009E73")

  deg_summary_long <- deg_long %>%
    dplyr::count(comparison, direction, name = "count") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comp_clean = as.character(comparison),
      comp_clean = dplyr::recode(comp_clean,
        "Wald_cell_cl18_vs_cl6_TGFb_24h" = "cl18 vs cl6 (TGFb 24h)",
        "Wald_trt_24h_cl18"             = "SB vs TGFb 24h (cl18)",
        "Wald_trt_24h_cl6"              = "SB vs TGFb 24h (cl6)",
        "Wald_trt_8d_cl18"              = "SB vs TGFb 8d (cl18)",
        "Wald_trt_8d_cl6"               = "SB vs TGFb 8d (cl6)"
      )
    )

  order_comp <- c(
    "SB vs TGFb 8d (cl18)",
    "SB vs TGFb 8d (cl6)",
    "SB vs TGFb 24h (cl18)",
    "SB vs TGFb 24h (cl6)",
    "cl18 vs cl6 (TGFb 24h)"
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    deg_summary_long,
    aes(
      x = factor(comp_clean, levels = order_comp),
      y = count,
      fill = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "NS", "Down"))
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("DEG summary per selected comparison (", file_tag, ")"),
      x = "",
      y = "Number of genes"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Direction", values = ok_pal, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw()

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_volcano_deseq2, "_DEG_summary_barplot_selected_", file_tag, ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, height = 6
  )

  ## Selection table: genes significant in at least one comparison (Up/Down)
  selectionDEG <- deg_merged %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, dplyr::all_of(cols_present)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_any(dplyr::all_of(cols_present), ~ . != "NS"))

  ## Consensus flags (only if these columns exist)
  col_24h_cl6  <- paste0("Wald_trt_24h_cl6",  suffix)
  col_24h_cl18 <- paste0("Wald_trt_24h_cl18", suffix)
  col_8d_cl6   <- paste0("Wald_trt_8d_cl6",   suffix)
  col_8d_cl18  <- paste0("Wald_trt_8d_cl18",  suffix)

  if (all(c(col_24h_cl6, col_24h_cl18) %in% colnames(selectionDEG))) {
    selectionDEG <- selectionDEG %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        consensus24h = ( .data[[col_24h_cl6]] == "Up"   & .data[[col_24h_cl18]] == "Up") |
                       ( .data[[col_24h_cl6]] == "Down" & .data[[col_24h_cl18]] == "Down")
      )
  }

  if (all(c(col_8d_cl6, col_8d_cl18) %in% colnames(selectionDEG))) {
    selectionDEG <- selectionDEG %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        consensus8d = ( .data[[col_8d_cl6]] == "Up"   & .data[[col_8d_cl18]] == "Up") |
                      ( .data[[col_8d_cl6]] == "Down" & .data[[col_8d_cl18]] == "Down")
      )
  }

  list(
    deg_long = deg_long,
    deg_summary = deg_summary,
    plot = p,
    selectionDEG = selectionDEG,
    cols_present = cols_present
  )
}

## -------------------------
## 4) Build BOTH summaries
## -------------------------
res_std <- make_deg_summary(
  deg_merged = deg_sel_merged,
  select_comp_present = select_comp_present,
  suffix = "_direction",
  file_tag = "standard",

)

)

## Unpack (optional convenience variables)

deg_summary_std     <- res_std$deg_summary
p_deg_summary_std   <- res_std$plot
selectionDEG_std    <- res_std$selectionDEG

deg_long_strict      <- res_strict$deg_long

print(deg_summary_std)

## 5) Save objects
save(

)
```

####make heatmap of DEGs from selectionDEG_std and selectionDEG_strict and DEG from cl6_SBvsTGF_8d (strong treatment and day effect)

```{r}
## ----------------------------
## Settings
## ----------------------------
order_conditions <- c(
  "cl6_TGF_ct","cl6_SB_24h","cl18_TGF_ct","cl18_SB_24h",
  "cl6_TGF_8d","cl6_SB_8d","cl18_TGF_8d","cl18_SB_8d"
)

cond_cols <- c(
  "cl6_TGF_ct"  ="#000000",
  "cl18_TGF_ct" ="#f0E442",
  "cl6_TGF_8d"  ="#CC79A7",
  "cl18_TGF_8d" ="#009E73",
  "cl6_SB_24h"  ="#0072B2",
  "cl18_SB_24h" ="#E69F00",
  "cl6_SB_8d"   ="#D55E00",
  "cl18_SB_8d"  ="#56B4E9"
)

scale_mode <- "row"     # "row" (z-score by gene), "column" (samples), or "none" (raw data)
k_clusters <- 6
heat_cols  <- viridisLite::viridis(256, option = "turbo")

## ----------------------------
## Build condition in colData order + annotation
## ----------------------------
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_wald)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tr_short = ifelse(treatment == "TGFb", "TGF", as.character(treatment)),
    time_lbl = dplyr::case_when(
      tt == "24h" & tr_short == "TGF" ~ "ct",
      tt == "24h" & tr_short == "SB"  ~ "24h",
      tt == "8d"                      ~ "8d",
      TRUE ~ as.character(tt)
    ),
    condition = paste(cell_type, tr_short, time_lbl, sep = "_"),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = order_conditions)
  )

sample_order <- rownames(cd)[order(cd$condition)]

ann_col <- data.frame(condition = cd$condition[match(sample_order, rownames(cd))])
rownames(ann_col) <- sample_order
ann_col$condition <- factor(as.character(ann_col$condition), levels = order_conditions)

ann_colors <- list(condition = cond_cols)

cond_vec <- as.character(ann_col$condition)
gaps <- which(cond_vec[-1] != cond_vec[-length(cond_vec)])

## ----------------------------
## Expression matrix: log2(norm+1) ordered by samples
## ----------------------------
mat <- log2(counts(dds_wald, normalized = TRUE) + 1)
mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

## ----------------------------
## Gene name mapping (gene_ID -> gene_name)
## ----------------------------
gene_map <- geneInfo_f %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name == "", gene_ID, gene_name))

id_to_name <- setNames(gene_map$gene_name, gene_map$gene_ID)

## ----------------------------
## Helper: plot + store one heatmap
##   - pdf_height automatic if NULL
##   - fontsize_row automatic when gene names are shown
## ----------------------------
plot_one_heatmap <- function(gene_ids,
                             hm_name,
                             show_gene_names = FALSE,
                             pdf_height = NULL) {

  gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
  gene_ids <- intersect(gene_ids, rownames(mat))

  if (length(gene_ids) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", hm_name, " (too few genes found in mat: ", length(gene_ids), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }

  sub <- mat[gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  ## Auto PDF height (if not provided)
  if (is.null(pdf_height)) {
    n_genes <- nrow(sub)
    pdf_height <- max(8, min(30, n_genes / 60))  # 60 genes ~ 1 inch; capped
  }

  labels_row    <- NULL
  show_rownames <- FALSE
  fontsize_row  <- NA

  ## Auto fontsize if showing gene names (more genes -> smaller font)
  if (show_gene_names) {
    labels_row <- unname(id_to_name[gene_ids])
    labels_row <- make.unique(labels_row)
    show_rownames <- TRUE

    n_genes <- nrow(sub)
    fontsize_row <- dplyr::case_when(
      n_genes <= 80   ~ 7,
      n_genes <= 150  ~ 6,
      n_genes <= 250  ~ 5,
      n_genes <= 400  ~ 4,
      TRUE            ~ 3
    )
  }

  hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    sub,
    color = heat_cols,
    scale = scale_mode,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    labels_row = labels_row,          # only used if show_gene_names=TRUE
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = show_rownames,
    fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
    gaps_col = gaps,
    main = paste0(hm_name, " (n=", nrow(sub), ", scale=", scale_mode, ")"),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  ## Cluster assignment (use gene_ID, safer for downstream)
  cl <- cutree(hm$tree_row, k = k_clusters)
  clusters_df <- data.frame(
    heatmap   = hm_name,
    gene_ID   = names(cl),
    gene_name = unname(id_to_name[names(cl)]),
    cluster   = as.integer(cl),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, gene_name)

  ## Save PDF
  out_pdf <- paste0(
    fname_prefix_gene_heatmap_deseq2, "_HEATMAP_", hm_name,
    "_n", nrow(sub), "_scale", scale_mode, "_k", k_clusters, ".pdf"
  )

  pdf(out_pdf, width = 10, height = pdf_height)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
  dev.off()

  message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

  list(
    gtable      = hm$gtable,
    clusters    = clusters_df,
    gene_ids    = gene_ids,
    gene_labels = labels_row
  )
}

## ----------------------------
## 1) Heatmaps from selectionDEG_* (NO gene names)
##   - selectionDEG_std
##   - selectionDEG_strict
##   - selectionDEG_strict50
##   - selectionDEG_strict100
## ----------------------------
stopifnot(
  exists("selectionDEG_std"),
  exists("selectionDEG_strict"),
  exists("selectionDEG_strict50"),
  exists("selectionDEG_strict100")
)

genes_std        <- selectionDEG_std$gene_ID
genes_strict     <- selectionDEG_strict$gene_ID
genes_strict50   <- selectionDEG_strict50$gene_ID
genes_strict100  <- selectionDEG_strict100$gene_ID

heatmap_store <- list()
cluster_store <- list()
genes_store   <- list()

res_std <- plot_one_heatmap(
  gene_ids = genes_std,
  hm_name = "selectionDEG_std",
  show_gene_names = FALSE,
  pdf_height = NULL
)
if (!is.null(res_std)) {
  heatmap_store[["selectionDEG_std"]] <- res_std$gtable
  cluster_store[["selectionDEG_std"]] <- res_std$clusters
  genes_store[["selectionDEG_std"]]   <- res_std$gene_ids
}

res_strict <- plot_one_heatmap(
  gene_ids = genes_strict,
  hm_name = "selectionDEG_strict",
  show_gene_names = FALSE,
  pdf_height = NULL
)
if (!is.null(res_strict)) {
  heatmap_store[["selectionDEG_strict"]] <- res_strict$gtable
  cluster_store[["selectionDEG_strict"]] <- res_strict$clusters
  genes_store[["selectionDEG_strict"]]   <- res_strict$gene_ids
}

res_strict50 <- plot_one_heatmap(
  gene_ids = genes_strict50,
  hm_name = "selectionDEG_strict50",
  show_gene_names = FALSE,
  pdf_height = NULL
)
if (!is.null(res_strict50)) {
```

####work on top 50 genes selected heatmap

```{r}

#### -------------------------------------------------------------------
#### EXTRA: clusterizzare SOLO l’heatmap selectionDEG_strict50
####   - taglio dendrogramma (k ~ 5-6)
####   - gaps tra cluster (gaps_row)
####   - annotation_row colorata per cluster
####   - tabella geni per cluster
####   - PDF height: come nel codice precedente (auto da n_genes)
#### -------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(grid)
})

## scegli quanti cluster vuoi
k_clusters_strict50 <- 5

## recupera i gene_ID usati per la heatmap strict50
stopifnot("selectionDEG_strict50" %in% names(genes_store))
gene_ids <- genes_store[["selectionDEG_strict50"]]

gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
gene_ids <- intersect(gene_ids, rownames(mat))

if (length(gene_ids) < 5) stop("Troppi pochi geni per selectionDEG_strict50: ", length(gene_ids))

sub <- mat[gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]

## --- PDF height AUTO (stessa formula del chunk precedente) ---
n_genes <- nrow(sub)
pdf_height <- max(8, min(30, n_genes / 60))  # 60 geni ~ 1 inch; capped

## 1) Prima passata: serve solo per ottenere tree_row (dendrogramma)
hm0 <- pheatmap(
  sub,
  color = heat_cols,
  scale = scale_mode,            # "row" = Z-score per gene (come nel tuo settaggio)
  annotation_col = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  gaps_col = gaps,
  silent = TRUE
)

## 2) Taglio del dendrogramma in k cluster
cl <- cutree(hm0$tree_row, k = k_clusters_strict50)   # names(cl) = gene_ID

## 3) Annotation row con cluster (colorata)
ann_row <- data.frame(cluster = factor(cl, levels = sort(unique(cl))))
rownames(ann_row) <- names(cl)

## colori cluster (semplici, robusti)
cluster_cols <- setNames(rainbow(k_clusters_strict50), levels(ann_row$cluster))
ann_row_colors <- list(cluster = cluster_cols)

## 4) gaps tra cluster secondo l’ordine del dendrogramma
row_order <- hm0$tree_row$order
cl_ord <- cl[row_order]
gaps_row <- which(cl_ord[-1] != cl_ord[-length(cl_ord)])

## 5) Heatmap finale: stesso albero, + annotation_row + gaps_row
hm_strict50_clustered <- pheatmap(
  sub,
  color = heat_cols,
  scale = scale_mode,
  annotation_col = ann_col,
  annotation_row = ann_row,
  annotation_colors = c(ann_colors, ann_row_colors),
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = hm0$tree_row,     # riuso lo stesso dendrogramma
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,           # tanti geni -> niente nomi
  gaps_col = gaps,
  gaps_row = gaps_row,
  main = paste0("selectionDEG_strict50 clustered (k=", k_clusters_strict50,
                ", n=", nrow(sub), ", scale=", scale_mode, ")"),
  silent = TRUE
)

## 6) Salva PDF (altezza = come codice precedente)
out_pdf <- paste0(
  fname_prefix_gene_heatmap_deseq2,
  "_HEATMAP_selectionDEG_strict50_clustered_k", k_clusters_strict50,
  "_n", nrow(sub), "_scale", scale_mode, ".pdf"
)

pdf(out_pdf, width = 10, height = pdf_height)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(hm_strict50_clustered$gtable)
dev.off()
message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

## 7) Tabella geni per cluster
clusters_strict50_df <- data.frame(
  heatmap   = "selectionDEG_strict50_clustered",
  gene_ID   = names(cl),
  gene_name = unname(id_to_name[names(cl)]),
  cluster   = as.integer(cl),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(cluster, gene_name)

write.table(
  clusters_strict50_df,
  file = paste0(
    fname_prefix_csv_deseq2,
    "_selectionDEG_strict50_clusters_k", k_clusters_strict50, ".txt"
  ),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

## 8) Aggiorna le liste (così puoi lavorare solo su questa heatmap dopo)
heatmap_store[["selectionDEG_strict50_clustered"]] <- hm_strict50_clustered$gtable
cluster_store[["selectionDEG_strict50_clustered"]] <- clusters_strict50_df
genes_store[["selectionDEG_strict50_clustered"]]   <- names(cl)

## (opzionale) salva anche questi oggetti aggiornati
saveRDS(genes_store,   paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_heatmap_geneIDs_sets.rds"))
saveRDS(heatmap_store, paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_heatmap_grobs_custom.rds"))
saveRDS(cluster_store, paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_gene_clusters_custom.rds"))
```

####GO on clusters top 50

```{r}
#### ============================================================
#### GO enrichment per cluster (HUMAN) - selectionDEG_strict50
#### ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})

stopifnot(exists("clusters_strict50_df"))

OrgDb_use <- org.Hs.eg.db

## ----------------------------
## Helper: decide keytype (ENSEMBL vs SYMBOL) + clean ENSG.version
## ----------------------------
strip_ensembl_version <- function(x) {
  # ENSG000001.12 -> ENSG000001
  sub("\\.\\d+$", "", x)
}

detect_keytype <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("SYMBOL")
  if (any(grepl("^ENSG", x))) return("ENSEMBL")
  return("SYMBOL")
}

## Scegli colonna migliore (preferisci gene_ID se ENSEMBL)
keytype_guess <- detect_keytype(clusters_strict50_df$gene_ID)
use_column <- if (keytype_guess == "ENSEMBL") "gene_ID" else "gene_name"
message("GO userà: ", use_column, " (keyType=", keytype_guess, ")")

## ----------------------------
## Universe/background: tutti i geni testati
## ----------------------------
universe_ids <- rownames(dds_wald)

if (keytype_guess == "ENSEMBL") {
  universe_keys <- strip_ensembl_version(universe_ids)
  universe_keytype <- "ENSEMBL"
} else {
 
  universe_keys <- universe_ids
  universe_keytype <- detect_keytype(universe_keys)
}

universe_map <- bitr(
  universe_keys,
  fromType = universe_keytype,
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = OrgDb_use
)
universe_entrez <- unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)

## ----------------------------
## Prepare list of genes per cluster
## ----------------------------
cluster_gene_tbl <- clusters_strict50_df %>%
  mutate(gene_key = .data[[use_column]]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_key), gene_key != "") %>%
  mutate(gene_key = if (keytype_guess == "ENSEMBL") strip_ensembl_version(gene_key) else gene_key) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(gene_key = list(unique(gene_key)), .groups = "drop")

## ----------------------------
## GO per cluster
## ----------------------------
run_go_one_cluster <- function(gene_keys, cl_id,
                               ont = "BP",
                               pCut = 0.05, qCut = 0.2,
                               minGS = 10, maxGS = 500) {

  kt <- detect_keytype(gene_keys)

  m <- bitr(
    gene_keys,
    fromType = kt,
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = OrgDb_use
  )

  gene_entrez <- unique(m$ENTREZID)
  gene_entrez <- gene_entrez[!is.na(gene_entrez)]

  if (length(gene_entrez) < minGS) {
    message("Cluster ", cl_id, " (", ont, "): troppo pochi geni mappati (", length(gene_entrez), "), skip.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene          = gene_entrez,
    universe      = universe_entrez,
    OrgDb         = OrgDb_use,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    ont           = ont,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = pCut,
    qvalueCutoff  = qCut,
    minGSSize     = minGS,
    maxGSSize     = maxGS,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) {
    message("Cluster ", cl_id, " (", ont, "): nessun termine significativo.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- as.data.frame(ego) %>%
    mutate(cluster = cl_id, ont = ont) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust)

  list(ego = ego, df = df, n_mapped = length(gene_entrez))
}

onts <- c("BP","MF","CC")
go_results_strict50 <- list()
go_tables_strict50  <- list()

for (ont in onts) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cluster_gene_tbl))) {
    cl_id <- cluster_gene_tbl$cluster[i]
    keys  <- cluster_gene_tbl$gene_key[[i]]

    out <- run_go_one_cluster(keys, cl_id, ont = ont)
    if (!is.null(out)) {
      nm <- paste0("strict50_cluster", cl_id, "_", ont)
      go_results_strict50[[nm]] <- out$ego
      go_tables_strict50[[nm]]  <- out$df
    }
  }
}

go_all_df_strict50 <- bind_rows(go_tables_strict50)

write.table(
  go_all_df_strict50,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GO_selectionDEG_strict50_byCluster_human.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

topN <- 15
if (length(go_results_strict50) > 0) {
  for (nm in names(go_results_strict50)) {
    ego <- go_results_strict50[[nm]]
    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix_volcano_deseq2, "_GO_", nm, "_dotplot_strict50.pdf")
    pdf(out_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
    print(dotplot(ego, showCategory = topN) + ggtitle(paste0("GO ", nm)))
    dev.off()
  }
}

save(
  go_results_strict50, go_tables_strict50, go_all_df_strict50,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_GO_selectionDEG_strict50_byCluster_human.RData")
)
```

####summary of GO clusters for top 100 and top 50 genes

```{r}
#### ============================================================
#### FINAL: GO summary (BP only) — Top 5 terms per cluster
#### Uses objects already created in memory:
####   - go_all_df_strict50   (from strict50 GO block)
####   - go_all_df_strict100  (from strict100 GO block)
#### Output:
####   - one summary table for strict50
####   - one summary table for strict100
####   - one combined table
#### ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
})

make_top_terms_per_cluster <- function(go_df, dataset_label, topN = 5) {

  stopifnot(!is.null(go_df), nrow(go_df) > 0)

  df <- go_df

  ## keep BP only (your tables should have ont + cluster because you added them earlier)
  if ("ont" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(.data$ont == "BP")

  ## pick the description column name you mentioned (you said go_all_df$description)
  desc_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    "description" %in% names(df) ~ "description",
    "Description" %in% names(df) ~ "Description",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(desc_col)) stop("No description/Description column found in ", dataset_label)

  ## pick the leading edge genes column: clusterProfiler uses geneID (ENTREZ IDs or SYMBOL if readable=TRUE)
  gene_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    "geneID" %in% names(df) ~ "geneID",
    "geneId" %in% names(df) ~ "geneId",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(gene_col)) stop("No geneID column found in ", dataset_label)

  ## we need a ranking to pick "top 5" terms; use p.adjust if present, else pvalue
  rank_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    "p.adjust" %in% names(df) ~ "p.adjust",
    "pvalue"  %in% names(df) ~ "pvalue",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(rank_col)) stop("No p.adjust or pvalue column found to rank terms in ", dataset_label)

  ## build output: 1 row per term
  out <- df %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_label) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data$cluster)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, cluster) %>%
    arrange(.data[[rank_col]], .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = topN) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = dataset,
      cluster = as.integer(cluster),
      GO_term = .data[[desc_col]],
      leading_edge = .data[[gene_col]]
    )

  out
}

## ----------------------------
## make tables (strict50 + strict100)
## ----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("go_all_df_strict50"), exists("go_all_df_strict100"))

top5_BP_terms_strict50  <- make_top_terms_per_cluster(go_all_df_strict50,  "selectionDEG_strict50",  topN = 5)
top5_BP_terms_strict100 <- make_top_terms_per_cluster(go_all_df_strict100, "selectionDEG_strict100", topN = 5)

## ----------------------------
## save (one file each + combined)
## ----------------------------
write.table(
  top5_BP_terms_strict50,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GO_BP_Top5_terms_perCluster_strict50.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  top5_BP_terms_strict100,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GO_BP_Top5_terms_perCluster_strict100.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

top5_BP_terms_combined <- bind_rows(top5_BP_terms_strict50, top5_BP_terms_strict100) %>%
  arrange(dataset, cluster)

write.table(
  top5_BP_terms_combined,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GO_BP_Top5_terms_perCluster_STRICT50_vs_STRICT100.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

message("Saved: BP top5 GO terms per cluster (1 row per term) + leading_edge genes.")
```


####build heatmap for top 100 genes for all selected comparisons

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(viridisLite)
  library(grid)
})

## ----------------------------
## Settings
## ----------------------------
order_conditions <- c(
  "cl6_TGF_ct","cl6_SB_24h","cl18_TGF_ct","cl18_SB_24h",
  "cl6_TGF_8d","cl6_SB_8d","cl18_TGF_8d","cl18_SB_8d"
)

cond_cols <- c(
  "cl6_TGF_ct"  ="#000000",
  "cl18_TGF_ct" ="#f0E442",
  "cl6_TGF_8d"  ="#CC79A7",
  "cl18_TGF_8d" ="#009E73",
  "cl6_SB_24h"  ="#0072B2",
  "cl18_SB_24h" ="#E69F00",
  "cl6_SB_8d"   ="#D55E00",
  "cl18_SB_8d"  ="#56B4E9"
)

scale_mode <- "row"     # "row" (z-score by gene), "column", or "none"
k_clusters <- 6
heat_cols  <- viridisLite::viridis(256, option = "turbo")

## ----------------------------
## Build condition in colData order + annotation
## ----------------------------
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_wald)) %>%
  mutate(
    tr_short = ifelse(treatment == "TGFb", "TGF", as.character(treatment)),
    time_lbl = case_when(
      tt == "24h" & tr_short == "TGF" ~ "ct",
      tt == "24h" & tr_short == "SB"  ~ "24h",
      tt == "8d"                      ~ "8d",
      TRUE ~ as.character(tt)
    ),
    condition = paste(cell_type, tr_short, time_lbl, sep = "_"),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = order_conditions)
  )

sample_order <- rownames(cd)[order(cd$condition)]

ann_col <- data.frame(condition = cd$condition[match(sample_order, rownames(cd))])
rownames(ann_col) <- sample_order
ann_col$condition <- factor(as.character(ann_col$condition), levels = order_conditions)

ann_colors <- list(condition = cond_cols)

cond_vec <- as.character(ann_col$condition)
gaps <- which(cond_vec[-1] != cond_vec[-length(cond_vec)])

## ----------------------------
## Expression matrix: log2(norm+1) ordered by samples
## ----------------------------
mat <- log2(counts(dds_wald, normalized = TRUE) + 1)
mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

## ----------------------------
## Gene name mapping (gene_ID -> gene_name)
## ----------------------------
gene_map <- geneInfo_f %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name == "", gene_ID, gene_name))

id_to_name <- setNames(gene_map$gene_name, gene_map$gene_ID)

## ----------------------------
## Helper: plot + store one heatmap (optionally show gene names)
## ----------------------------
plot_one_heatmap <- function(gene_ids,
                             hm_name,
                             show_gene_names = FALSE,
                             #pdf_height = 20 # optional if you want a specific height and in that case unmute and mute the one below
                             pdf_height = NULL) {

  gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
  gene_ids <- intersect(gene_ids, rownames(mat))

  if (length(gene_ids) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", hm_name, " (too few genes found in mat: ", length(gene_ids), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }

  sub <- mat[gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  ## Auto PDF height (se non specificata)
  if (is.null(pdf_height)) {
    n_genes <- nrow(sub)
    pdf_height <- max(8, min(30, n_genes / 60))  # 60 geni ~ 1 inch
  }

  labels_row <- NULL
  show_rownames <- FALSE
  fontsize_row <- 6

  if (show_gene_names) {
    labels_row <- unname(id_to_name[gene_ids])
    labels_row <- make.unique(labels_row)
    show_rownames <- TRUE
    fontsize_row <- 6
  }

  hm <- pheatmap(
    sub,
    color = heat_cols,
    scale = scale_mode,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    labels_row = labels_row,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = show_rownames,
    fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
    gaps_col = gaps,
    main = paste0(hm_name, " (n=", nrow(sub), ", scale=", scale_mode, ")"),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  # Cluster assignment (use gene_ID, safer)
  cl <- cutree(hm$tree_row, k = k_clusters)
  clusters_df <- data.frame(
    heatmap   = hm_name,
    gene_ID   = names(cl),
    gene_name = unname(id_to_name[names(cl)]),
    cluster   = as.integer(cl),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% arrange(cluster, gene_name)

  out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix_gene_heatmap_deseq2, "_HEATMAP_", hm_name,
                    "_n", nrow(sub), "_scale", scale_mode, "_k", k_clusters, ".pdf")

  pdf(out_pdf, width = 10, height = pdf_height)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
  dev.off()

  message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

  list(
    gtable = hm$gtable,
    clusters = clusters_df,
    gene_ids = gene_ids,
    gene_labels = labels_row
  )
}

## ----------------------------
## Outputs containers
## ----------------------------
heatmap_store <- list()
cluster_store <- list()
genes_store   <- list()

## ============================================================
## 1) Heatmaps from selectionDEG_std and selectionDEG_strict
##    (many genes -> NO gene names)
## ============================================================
stopifnot(exists("selectionDEG_std"), exists("selectionDEG_strict"))

}

)
if (!is.null(res_strict)) {

  cluster_store[["selectionDEG_strict"]] <- res_strict$clusters
  genes_store[["selectionDEG_strict"]]   <- res_strict$gene_ids
}

stopifnot("Wald_trt_8d_cl6" %in% names(deg_results_list_TC))
```

```{r}
genes <- as.numeric(genes_cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX$cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX_log2FC)
names(genes) <- genes_cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX$gene_name

genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TMM=genes

names(genes) <- genes_cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM$gene_name
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM=genes

genes <- as.numeric(genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM$cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM_log2FC)
names(genes) <- genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM$gene_name
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM=genes

genes <- as.numeric(genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb$cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb_log2FC)
names(genes) <- genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb$gene_name
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb=genes

genes <- as.numeric(genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi$cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi_log2FC)
names(genes) <- genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi$gene_name

genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi=genes

genes <- as.numeric(genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb$cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb_log2FC)
names(genes) <- genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb$gene_name
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb=genes

gene_sets_GSEA <- list(
  "cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX" = genes_cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX,
  "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TMM"    = genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TMM,
  "cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM"  = genes_cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM,
  "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM"  = genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM,
  "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb"  = genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb,
  "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi"  = genes_cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi,
  "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb"  = genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb
)

# Ensure each element is a named numeric vector (values = logFC, names = SYMBOL)
stopifnot(all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && !is.null(names(x)))))

# Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZ, then rebuild ranked vectors in ENTREZ space
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(bitr(
  unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
  fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db
))

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  # join to map to ENTREZ
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym), rank = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by="SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) next

  # deduplicate ENTREZ if necessary (keep max |rank|)
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea <- gseGO(geneList      = ranks_entrez,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = "ENTREZID",
                ont           = "BP",
                minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,#place this automatic
                maxGSSize     = 500,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 1,
                nPermSimple = 10000,# readable=TRUE,
                verbose       = FALSE, by = "fgsea")
  
gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

# filter significant terms
# Make a new list of GSEA results filtered by significance
gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # filter by adjusted p-value < 0.05
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  
  # replace the result slot with filtered df
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# 1) Write every GO table to CSV: GO_<name>.csv

    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# Helper: save ggplot if it exists
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w=8, h=10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# Make a dotplot per GSEA result in gsea_list
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width=8, height=6) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    # Skip NULL or empty results
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }

    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))

    # GSEA-friendly dotplot: split by .sign for up/down, order by NES
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) { message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
    )

    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, show_k = 10)


# Vector of target GO IDs ###ID studied before
go_ids <- c("GO:0007059","GO:0030855","GO:002240","GO:0070252","GO:0006936") # 

# Function: loop through GO IDs for a given contrast
save_gsea_plots <- function(gsea_res, contrast_name, go_ids, prefix, width=8, height=6) {
  for (go_id in go_ids) {
    if (go_id %in% gsea_res@result$ID) {
      p <- gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = go_id, title = go_id)
      out_file <- paste0(prefix, "_", contrast_name, "_", gsub(":", "-", go_id), ".pdf")
      ggsave(out_file, plot = p, width = width, height = height)
      message("Saved: ", out_file)
    } else {
      message("GO term ", go_id, " not found in ", contrast_name)
    }
  }
}

save_gsea_plots(gsea_list[["cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM"]], "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM", go_ids, fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2)
save_gsea_plots(gsea_list[["cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb"]], "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb", go_ids, fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2)
```

####Running GSEA on the custom gene list

```{r}

###one by one GSEA
#gene_ranks <- genes_cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX
#gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

#term2gene <- stack(gs)
#colnames(term2gene) <- c("gene", "term")
#term2gene <- term2gene[, c("term", "gene")]

# Run GSEA
#gsea_custom <- GSEA(
 # geneList = gene_ranks,
  #TERM2GENE = term2gene,
  #minGSSize = 5,
  #maxGSSize = 500,
  #pvalueCutoff = 1,
  #verbose = FALSE,
  #seed = TRUE
#)

#as.data.frame(gsea_custom)[, c("ID", "Description", "NES", "pvalue", "p.adjust")]

# Parameters
set_min_n_genes <- 3
p_cutoff <- 1

# --- Prepare TERM2GENE mapping from your gene sets ---
term2gene <- stack(gs)
colnames(term2gene) <- c("gene", "term")
term2gene <- term2gene[, c("term", "gene")]

# --- Initialize result containers ---
gsea_list_custom   <- list()
GSEA_tables_custom <- list()

# --- Loop over each comparison in your ranked gene lists ---
for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  message("Running custom GSEA for: ", nm)
  
  # Extract ranked genes (log2FC values)
  gene_ranks <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]
  gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # Run clusterProfiler::GSEA on your custom gene sets
  gsea_custom <- tryCatch({
    GSEA(
      geneList      = gene_ranks,
      TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = p_cutoff,
      verbose       = FALSE,
      seed          = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  if (is.null(gsea_custom) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_custom)) == 0) {
    message("No enrichment found for ", nm)
    next
  }
  
  # Save objects
  gsea_list_custom[[nm]]   <- gsea_custom
  GSEA_tables_custom[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_custom)
}

# --- Filter significant results (adjusted p < 0.05) ---
gsea_sig_list_custom <- lapply(gsea_list_custom, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# --- Write GSEA tables to CSV ---
if (length(GSEA_tables_custom)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables_custom)) {
    df <- GSEA_tables_custom[[nm]]
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) next
    
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_CustomGSEA_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(df, file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# --- Helper function to save plots ---
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# --- Generate dotplots for each comparison ---
plot_gsea_dotplots_custom <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width = 8, height = 6) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    
    # Safely convert to data frame
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }
    
    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))
    
    # --- FIXED: added missing closing parenthesis and split handling ---
    p <- tryCatch({
      dotplot(
        g,
        showCategory = k,
        split = ".sign",
        orderBy = "NES",
        title = paste0("Custom GSEA: ", nm)
      ) + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
    
    # Save PDF
    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_CustomGSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots_custom(gsea_list_custom, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, show_k = 10)

# --- Save the workspace for reproducibility ---
Rdata_filename <- paste0(fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, "_CustomGSEA_analysis.RData")
save(gsea_list_custom, GSEA_tables_custom, gsea_sig_list_custom, gs, term2gene, file = Rdata_filename)
message("Saved RData: ", Rdata_filename)

```
